name: Skill Authoring
description: Generate Prismer-compliant skill drafts from user intent, documentation URLs, existing code, or service endpoints. Wraps Anthropic skill-creator's writing knowledge into an executable pipeline that emits multi-file manifest v1 and persists as status=draft via cloud endpoint.

inputs.name: sourceKind
inputs.description: Source kind chosen by the user or inferred from the slash command

inputs.name: intent
inputs.description: Free-form description of what the produced skill should do; ≥ 50 chars

inputs.name: sourceRefs
inputs.description: URLs / repo paths / endpoint URLs depending on sourceKind

sampleTasks.title: Author a skill from an OpenClaw documentation URL
sampleTasks.prompt: /skill new --from doc https://docs.openclaw.ai/skills/index — make a skill that scrapes the OpenClaw tools catalog and bundles it as a reference
expectedArtifacts: SKILL.md with frontmatter (name, description, license, compatibility)
acceptanceCriteria: IMSkill row exists with status=draft and slug matches user-provided value
